_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 0: jump table, game set-up, game over, title, renderer, credits ($8000-$89F8). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8000`
regions.description: `JMP $97A0`: the sound engine's init (all channels silent).

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8003`
regions.description: `JMP $805B`: the game set-up. Caller: bank 7 `$FF6E`.

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8006`
regions.description: `JMP $97CC`: play sound A (the sound engine's entry; bank 7 `$D852` calls it).

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8009`
regions.description: `JMP $917C`: the sound engine's per-frame tick (the NMI).

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: slot `$800C`
regions.description: `JMP $8332`: the title screen and its menu (bank 7 `$FF50`).

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: slot `$800F`
regions.description: `JMP $81DD`: GAME OVER (bank 6 `$8247`, far call `00 0E 80`).

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8012`
regions.description: `JMP $88F5`: the starfield screen of the scene after corridor 21 (bank 7 `$ECCD`).

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8015`
regions.description: `JMP $8915`: the credits (the ending; never returns).

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8018`
regions.description: `JMP $8034`: the ATTACK / SHIELD pip tiles into CHR (bank 5's status screen open).

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: pip tiles (`$8034`)
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with an inline item of 32 bytes for CHR `$1CC0`: **tiles `$CC` and `$CD`**, the level pips of the status screen's ATTACK and SHIELD bars (`7E 7E 7E 7E 7E 3C 08 00 80 EC 80 EC EC 68 30 00` and `BE BA 00 36 0E 0E 0E 00 00 BE 00 12 0A 0A 0E 00`: two 8-byte planes each).

regions.name: BANK 0 JUMP TABLE: return
regions.description: `RTS` (of the pip routine).

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): clear the game state
GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): which start mode?
regions.description: `$2F` = 2 (CONTINUE) goes on; any other mode goes to `$80A3`.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): mode 2, normal game
regions.description: `$30` bit 1 clear (not a TGL game) jumps to `$80C8`: **only the position is restored**.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): mode 2, TGL game
regions.description: `$47` := `$78` (the max life kept at the last record) and the six score digits `$0170-$0175` cleared.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): modes 0, 1, 3
regions.description: The corridor seals `$04B1`, `$04B2` and the bonus threshold `$017C-$017E` (0, 0, 3) cleared.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): mode 0 = a new game
regions.description: A zero mode goes to `$80D4`.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): modes 1 and 3: catch the threshold up
regions.description: With `$30` bit 2 (quiet) set, **0 points are added to the score** (`$C057`): the bonus threshold is stepped up to the restored score without a jingle.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): restore the position
regions.description: `$52/$53` := `$7C/$7D` (the progress record); A := `$20` and on to `$8143`.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): a new game: clear
regions.description: The 19 bytes of the progress array `$04A0-$04B2` cleared, chip level `$46`, fire rate `$6B`, chips `$4C/$4D` := 0, max life `$47` := `$40`; the score digits and `$04B3-$04B8` cleared.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): a new game: start values
regions.description: Position `$52/$53` and the record `$7C/$7D` := (11, 12); attack `$4A` and shield `$4B` := 1.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): demo or not?
regions.description: **Start held at power-on (`$F7` bit 4) or a TGL game skips the demo**, going straight to `$8143`; otherwise the demo state follows.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): the demo state
regions.description: Max life `$47` := `$80`; weapons all level 2 (`$04AC-$04AE` := `$AA`); attack and shield 2, chip level 6, fire rate 2; a random weapon `$3C` (a random 0-15, 12 and over replaced by 1).

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): the demo flag
GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): common end
regions.description: `$30` |= A; `$A0` := 3; life `$48` := `$47`; `JSR $C006` with `02 17 80` (bank 2 `$8018`: CHIP MAX from the chip level).

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): chips
regions.description: A demo or a second-item start (`$2F` = 1: a password) fills the chips to the maximum (`$4C/$4D` := `$4E/$4F`).

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): the demo's timers
regions.description: `$F0` := `$1C` (the demo's length, x 256 frames), `$F4` := a random 0-31 (the pattern index), `$F2` := 1.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): clear both nametables
GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): the HUD's labels
regions.description: `JSR $C06C` (attributes of nametable 1 `$27C0`: 64 x 0);

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): the split marker
regions.description: `JSR $C06C` with `01 23 00 FE`: tile `$FE` at `$2300` (nametable 0 row 24, column 0);

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): SC
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `02 27 20 'SC'`: SC at PPU `$2720`;

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): SHOT
GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): 0 CHIP
GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): the chip counter
regions.description: `LDA #0 / JSR $C12F`: add 0 chips - the counter drawn, the gun tier set.

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): the shot icon
regions.description: `JSR $C006` with `05 32 80` (bank 5 `$8033`: the HUD's shot icon).

regions.name: GAME SET-UP (bank 0 `$805B`, slot `$8003`; start modes `$2F`): the HUD's tiles
regions.description: `$A2` := 0; the decompressor armed with block 2 of bank 2 into CHR `$1FE0` (the split tile `$FE` and the meter tile) and block 1 of bank 2 into CHR `$1100`; `JMP $C045` waits for both.

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): the dying ship
regions.description: `JSR $C14A` (the stage step) and `$C024` (a pass) until slot 0's type is 0: the ship's explosion plays out. A demo (`$30` bit 7) goes to the title (`JMP $C14D`).

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): the GAME OVER jingle
regions.description: Sound `$0A`, `$0300` := 0; then every pass: the stage step, the new Start press (a press ends it), the bank 6 object loop (`06 FF 7F`), the HUD and the decompressor, until the song-end flag `$0300` is set.

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): the jingle: HUD, decompressor, song end
regions.description: `JSR $C153` (the HUD), `JSR $C156` (the decompressor), and round again until `$0300` is non-zero.

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): the screen
regions.description: Fade out, `$30` bit 4 cleared, rendering off, the scroll reset, nametable 0 cleared and the sprites hidden, the attributes cleared, then `JSR $C06F` with `09 21 4B 'GAME OVER'` at `$214B`.

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): GAME OVER
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `09 21 4B 'GAME OVER'` (at `$214B`).

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): corridor 0: no continue
regions.description: A normal game (`$30` bit 1 clear) in corridor 0 (`$30` bit 6 set, `$51` = 0): the text palette, then **up to 120 frames (a Start press ends it earlier) and a fade out to the title (`JMP $C14D`)**. All other deaths go on.

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): keep only the TGL bit
regions.description: `$30` := `$30` AND 2. **In a TGL game with chip level 7 or more and fewer than 250 chips the chips are raised to 250.**

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): CONTINUE PUSH START: the text
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with the item `14 21 A7 'CONTINUE  PUSH START'` (at `$21A7`).

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): CONTINUE: wait for Start
regions.description: The text palette (`$82B0`), then waits for a new Start: **it sets `$2F` := 2 (CONTINUE), fades out and starts the game (`JMP $C150`)**.

regions.name: GAME OVER AND CONTINUE (bank 0 `$81DD`, slot `$800F`): the text palette (`$82B0`)
regions.description: Colours `$0181` := `$30` (white) and `$0183` := `$16` (red), `JMP $C0DE` (fade in).

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): set-up (`$82C5`)
regions.description: `JSR $97A8` (silence the sound engine), `SEI`, rendering off, PPUCTRL := `$30`, the decompressor idle; block 1 of bank 2 -> CHR `$1270`, then blocks 0 of bank 0 into CHR `$1000` and block 1 into CHR `$1800` (the title's tile sets, `$8030`), the sprites hidden; far call bank 2 `$8000` (font set 0); nametable 0 cleared, its attributes := `$55`; **the title picture is drawn from the script at `$84F7` (`$8485`)** and the eight title palettes `$82BD` are loaded; the scroll reset.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the title picture: clear (`$8315`)
regions.description: Nametable 0 cleared (`$C018`) and `JSR $C06C` with `40 23 C0 55` (the attribute table := `$55`).

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the title picture: draw
regions.description: **The title picture is drawn from the script at `$84F7` (`$8485`)**, the eight title palettes `$82BD` loaded (`$C05D`) and `JMP $C01B` resets the scroll.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the title (`$8332`)
regions.description: `JSR $82C5`, `JSR $C063` (the picture on), `$30` and `$2F` := 0, the pads read (`$C01E`); **A + B held and nothing else (`$F7` = `$C0`) far-calls bank 3 `$801B`, the SOUND TEST**.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the title song
regions.description: Song 1 (`JSR $97CC`), the idle timer `$F0:$F1` := 7 x 256.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): wait for Start
regions.description: A new Start goes to the menu (`$8430`). **The song ending (`$0300` non-zero) returns to the caller - which starts the demo.** Otherwise the timer runs out in about 30 seconds and the story screen follows.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the story screen: clear
regions.description: Fade out (`$C0ED`), nametable 0 cleared and its attributes `40 23 C0 00` set.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the story screen: draw
regions.description: The story text script `$86E8` drawn at PPU `$2080` (`$8495`), the 14-byte palette `$8473` into `$0180-$018D`, the scroll `$FC` := `$28`, fade in.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the text reveal
regions.description: `$F0` (starting at 2) counts the rows: every 8th frame the attribute bytes of one row (`$23C0` + ...) are changed to the next palette of three (`$847F`): **the story's text appears row by row by attribute changes**; after `$46` the screen fades out and the title comes back (`JMP $835A`); a Start press goes to the menu (`$8421`).

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): Start during the story
regions.description: Fade out, the title picture again (`$8315`), the menu text (`$8822`), picture on, `JMP $8433`.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): Start at the title
regions.description: `JSR $8822`: the menu text (the script `$8836` at `$2220`).

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the menu: the attribute
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `01 23 E9 33` (attribute byte `$23E9` := `$33`).

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the menu: the loop
regions.description: The cursor drawn (`$845B`); **Start leaves the menu (returning `$2F` to the boot code: 0 = the first item, a new game; 1 = the second item, the password screen); Select, Up or Down toggle `$2F`, redraw the cursor and play sound `$33`.**

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the cursor (`$845B`)
regions.description: `$2F` zero draws `':  '` at PPU `$2286` through `JSR $C06F`;

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the cursor: return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the cursor, second item
TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: SCREEN SCRIPT RENDERER (bank 0 `$8485`, `$8495`): the title picture (`$8485`)
regions.description: PPU `$2000` and the pointer `$84F7` set, and on into the renderer.

regions.name: SCREEN SCRIPT RENDERER (bank 0 `$8485`, `$8495`): render a script (`$8495`)
regions.description: A script at `$17:$16`, PPU row address `$19:$18`: per element `[column][count]` and the characters; a column of `$FE` or more ends the row (`$FF`) or the script (`$FE`); **bit 7 of the count = repeat one character** (the same byte re-read); each element is one queue item (reserved, committed). After a row the PPU address += `$20`.

regions.name: SCREEN SCRIPT RENDERER (bank 0 `$8485`, `$8495`): end of a row
regions.description: The script pointer advanced; `$18` += `$20`; `FE` ends (Z set), `FF` goes on to the next row.

regions.name: SCREEN SCRIPT RENDERER (bank 0 `$8485`, `$8495`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: TITLE SCREEN (bank 0 `$8332`, slot `$800C`): the menu text (`$8822`)
CREDITS AND THE LAST SCREENS (bank 0 `$88F5`, `$8915`): the starfield screen (`$88F5`, slot `$8012`)
regions.description: Title set-up (`$82C5`), the scroll `$A6` := `$80`, the scroll committed, the menu text script (`$8822`), then the script `$88B7` at `$21A0` (the scene after corridor 21's stars).

regions.name: CREDITS AND THE LAST SCREENS (bank 0 `$88F5`, `$8915`): the credits (`$8915`, slot `$8015`)
regions.description: `JSR $C006` with `02 FF 7F` (bank 2 `$8000`, font set 0), the screen counter `$F0` := 0, the script pointer := `$89F9`.

regions.name: CREDITS AND THE LAST SCREENS (bank 0 `$88F5`, `$8915`): the credits: set-up
regions.description: The screen counter `$F0` := 0 and the script pointer `$17:$16` := `$89F9`.

regions.name: CREDITS AND THE LAST SCREENS (bank 0 `$88F5`, `$8915`): a screen
regions.description: The next script drawn at `$2220` (`$8495`; the renderer leaves the pointer past its `FE`), the fade-in target `$04D9` := `$30`, ten passes of the crawl (`$89B6`) while the fade steps (`$C16E`) until it is done.

regions.name: CREDITS AND THE LAST SCREENS (bank 0 `$88F5`, `$8915`): after the fade-in
regions.description: **Nine screens (`$F0` 0-8)**: screen 1 starts the two crawling sprites (y `$54`); the wait is `$8BB2[n]` seconds of 60 passes; then the fade out (`$04D9` := `$0F`, three passes at a time), ten rows cleared at `$2220`, and `JMP $8927`.

regions.name: CREDITS AND THE LAST SCREENS (bank 0 `$88F5`, `$8915`): the last screen
regions.description: `$F0` = 8: wait for a new Start (`$C01E`, `$F5` bit 4) and the tenth screen (PASSWORD TGL) follows; otherwise the crawl runs for ever (`JMP $899F`).

regions.name: CREDITS AND THE LAST SCREENS (bank 0 `$88F5`, `$8915`): the crawl (`$89B6`)
regions.description: Y passes: `$41`++, sprite 1's tile alternates 1 / 2 every other frame; every 8th frame sprites 0 and 1 move one pixel left (`$89E2`; when the x wraps the sprite is hidden); one frame is waited each pass.
